title: Add service
description: Choose a service and review its routing and DNS rules before adding them to the draft.
empty: No matching services. Try another search.
refine: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Narrow your search to see other matches.
configureOutbound: Add a connection in Outbounds or configure a direct outbound in Editor.
subscriptionPending: Apply the draft to let the router load servers from the new subscription.
subscriptionGroupPending: Apply the draft to make the new group available to the core.
subscriptionLoading: Checking which subscription servers the core lists…
subscriptionLoaded_zero: The core lists no servers from the applied subscriptions yet.
subscriptionLoaded_one: The core lists {{count}} subscription server. Pairing its route and DNS is unavailable in the catalog.
subscriptionLoaded_other: The core lists {{count}} subscription servers. Pairing their routes and DNS is unavailable in the catalog.
subscriptionGroupLoaded_zero: The core lists no subscription servers in this group yet.
subscriptionGroupLoaded_one: The core lists {{count}} subscription server in this group.
subscriptionGroupLoaded_other: The core lists {{count}} subscription servers in this group.
allDevices: The rules cover all devices whose traffic passes through the core.
chooseResolver: Choose which resolver to use for this service.
stale: The draft changed. Review the updated rules before adding the service.

blocker.core: These rules have not been verified for the current core ({{detail}}).
blocker.draft: The draft cannot be read safely. Check the configuration in Editor.
blocker.service: The domain match for “{{detail}}” cannot be verified. Choose a catalog domain set.
blocker.exit: The DNS path through “{{detail}}” cannot be verified. Choose another outbound or configure a direct connection or compatible SOCKS5 server in Editor.
blocker.subscriptionExit: The catalog cannot pair DNS through the subscription group “{{detail}}”. Use a verified outbound such as a direct connection or a compatible SOCKS5 server.
blocker.resolver: No compatible DNS resolver for {{detail}}. Configure a resolver with a matching connection.
blocker.ingress: The draft does not establish how the core will receive DNS queries and recognize service domains. Check the inbounds and routing rules.
blocker.setConflict: The set “{{detail}}” conflicts with another entry. Check its source and tag in Editor.
blocker.routeConflict: Routing rule #{{detail}} may change the path for this service. Review it in Editor.
blocker.dnsConflict: DNS rule #{{detail}} may change how this service is resolved. Review it in Editor.

changedOnDevice: The router configuration changed after this draft was started. Review the draft against the current configuration before adding a service.
unsupportedSetting: The DNS path with the setting “{{detail}}” has not been verified.
